answer: Time keeps the willow, the ledger keeps the tide, the toy shop keeps the pulse; the farm keeps nothing but its printer. The paint log, read once, ends arguments that a hundred assurances cannot. Every applicant faces the same trial, Barrel filler plum slivovitz warrant distilled at the bottling room, and every verdict reads the same way: each plum slivovitz is a stilling record witnessed by the excise officer. Proof sells at 163 POA a piece; the farm's 596 pieces lock 97148 POA away, gone for good if it cheats.
